newsitem.title: USA: US House tax committee delays Rubin testimony.
newsitem.headline: US House tax committee delays Rubin testimony.

text.p: The tax-writing House ways and means committee moved back by three hours a scheduled Tuesday session at which Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin was scheduled to testify.
The committee hearing now is to begin at 1300 EST/1800 GMT, instead of at 1000 EST/1500 GMT, to hear Rubin testify on the Clinton administration's fiscal 1998 budget proposals.

Rubin postponed appearing at a Senate budget committee meeting on Monday because he was ill. Treasury said it would confirm on Tuesday whether or not he was well enough to testify before the House committee.
